title: Award Credential
description: Official praise of the issuee by the issuer. An award proves formal recognition; it does not of itself confer privileges.

t.description: Message type. Optional; an ACDC JSON message without it is of type acm.

u.description: Salty nonce that blinds this credential's SAID

i.description: AID of the issuer conferring the award

rd.description: SAID of the registry whose TEL carries this credential's issuance and revocation. Optional: a casual recognition issued registry-free is coherent, and an award's own text does not promise revocability the way a licence does.

u.description: Salty nonce that blinds this block against confirmation by recomputation

i.description: Issuee: the AID of the award's recipient

dt.description: When the award was issued, as an ISO-8601 datetime

validFrom.description: When the award becomes public, as an ISO-8601 datetime. May be before or after issuance; absent means on issuance.

validUntil.description: When the recognition stops, as an ISO-8601 datetime. Rarely used — most awards do not expire — and absent means the issuer set no horizon, never that it is perpetual.

issuerName.description: Self-asserted name of the issuer. A convenience for human readers; carries no verification weight, and may be empty.

category.description: A formal category for the award — a Nobel prize in the literature category, say.

timeframe.description: A timeframe the award applies to — an employee-of-the-month award for July 2026, say.

details.description: The identifying layer: issuee name, citation and image. Compacts to a SAID so a holder can prove the award without disclosing them.

oneOf.description: Details: the layer a holder discloses last

u.description: Salty nonce that blinds this block. Required: without it, a verifier holding the block's SAID could confirm a guessed name or citation, which would defeat the layer this block exists to create.

issueeName.description: Name of the issuee, as asserted by the issuer. A convenience for human readers; carries no verification weight, and may be empty.

citation.description: Formal praise designed to be displayed and quoted — 'For running the 2024 Olympic Marathon in Paris in 2:01:03', or 'In recognition of many years of dedicated service'. May be empty.

image.description: A data URL (RFC 2397), an ordinary URL, or the SAID/digest of an image that accompanies this award. An ordinary URL commits the issuer to a location, not to specific content — see imageByReferenceMayChange.

d.description: SAID of this edges block. Optional for the reason @enr3eg made a.d optional: the builder issuers use emits no block SAID.

issuer.description: Edge to a credential that establishes who the issuer is. A vLEI credential is a good choice where one exists.

n.description: SAID of a credential that proves the issuer's identity

o.description: Operator: the issuer AID of this ACDC MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to

r.description: Rules section. Optional, and open by deliberate exception: an award's terms are its issuer's to set (the Oscars and an employee recognition do not share a ruleset), so this schema does not enumerate clauses. A recommended baseline is published in rules.json; an issuer that uses it inherits the unrecognizedClauseFailsClosed obligation with it.

oneOf.description: Rules detail, whose clause vocabulary belongs to the issuer
